comparisons.reason: They measure different constructs. Feature 0 is quotation presence: any comment that directly quotes OP title or argument text, with no endorsement or challenge required. Feature 1 is any comment giving a reasoned, evidence-based counterargument to the OP's view, which excludes bare disagreement. A quoting comment need not argue against the OP, and a substantive counterargument need not quote. The null rules also differ. Feature 0 returns null for an empty list, which is contradictory within its own spec, while feature 1 returns 0 for an empty list.
